workflow: Leon requested seven fixes first, then the full run with each new icon pushed and shown immediately.

icons.name: Bulwark
icons.action: Wick braces a tall riot shield in a low side-on lunge, bullets bouncing off its front, a tiny Wick silhouette crouched safe behind it.

icons.name: Shrug It Off
icons.action: Wick, half-hunched, straightens with one big shoulder shrug that flings a heavy iron shackle off its back to clang away.

icons.name: Used to the Pain
icons.action: Knocked to one knee by a big brick that just bounced off its head, Wick is already springing up, fists raised.

icons.name: Scar Tissue
icons.action: Wick sits calmly and holds its riveted, patch-plated arm straight into a big tongue of fire, as if warming it.

icons.name: Wind on the Skin
icons.action: Wick kneels, eyes closed, one mitten raised into a long wind streak that curls past it and ends at a pair of eyes in the dark.

icons.name: Bedside Manner
icons.action: Wick leans in and clasps a hand entering frame in both mittens, a warm firm handshake, head tilted to listen.

icons.name: Breaching Strike
icons.action: Wick swings a sledgehammer bigger than itself through a sandbag barricade in a full twisting follow-through, sandbags flying back.

icons.name: Grapple
icons.action: Wick clamps itself around a huge armoured forearm entering frame, arms and legs wrapped tight, boots off the ground, refusing to let go.

icons.name: Into the Dark
icons.action: Wick steps through a large stone arch into the dark, body and head turned three-quarter toward the viewer at the threshold; large visible pixel-screen face and cape, darkness beyond the arch.
icons.screen: Determined visible pixel eyes and a small confident smile

icons.name: Iron Stomach
icons.action: Wick sits with legs stuck out, happily slurping straight from a dented tin can that pours out thick wavy stink lines.

icons.name: Grim Reaper
icons.action: Wick, cape pulled up into a hood, leans casually on a scythe taller than itself as three AP pips spark up off the blade; a shadow flees at the frame edge.

icons.name: Bone Talk
icons.action: Wick leans right into the viewer, screen close and foreshortened, slowly clacking a big pair of pliers between them.

icons.name: Wall Run
icons.action: Wick runs sideways along a vertical wall, body parallel to the ground, cape streaming, above a gap that drops away below.

icons.name: Roll With It
icons.action: Wick tumbles in a tight forward roll, curled into a ball, as a big sword blade sweeps through the air just above it.

icons.name: Origami Hands
icons.action: Wick squats on its heels folding a scrap sheet into a big toothy bear trap, the last fold snapping into place.

icons.name: Running Reload
icons.action: Wick sprints mid-stride, slapping a fresh magazine into a big pistol, motion lines behind both feet.

icons.name: Rounding Up
icons.action: Wick leans on a battery cell as tall as itself, cheekily pushing its half-full charge mark up to the top with one mitten.

icons.name: Catch
icons.action: Wick leaps and snatches a grenade out of the air one-handed, body already twisting to wind back for the throw.

icons.name: Sleight of Hand
icons.action: On tiptoe, Wick slips a round fused bomb into a big coat pocket hanging into frame, its other mitten raised for hush.

icons.name: Shadow Step
icons.action: Wick crouches with its back pressed flat to a chunk of broken wall, peeking round the edge, one boot lifted for the next dash.

icons.name: Jury-Rig
icons.action: Wick kneels, bracing a cracked rifle wrapped in thick tape on its knee as it coughs out one last sputtering shot.

icons.name: Hot-Swap
icons.action: Mid-twirl on one boot, Wick flips a pistol behind its back from one mitten to the other, a curved swap arrow looping around its waist.

icons.name: Got You in My Sight
icons.action: Wick lunges and snatches the hem of a dashed-outline cloak as it fades to nothing; its wearer is already gone.

icons.name: Eyes in the Back
icons.action: Seen from behind, cape prominent, Wick holds a big round hand-mirror up over its shoulder, watching the way it isn't facing.
icons.screen: One wide eye, seen in the mirror

icons.name: Hold the Stroke
icons.action: Wick braces an Evoker in both mittens, knees buckling, as a tall stack of unreleased geometric sigil strokes hovers queued over its muzzle.

icons.name: Parallel Thought
icons.action: Wick sits with one knee up, drawing a new geometric sigil with its Evoker while a finished sigil still spins on its free mitten.

icons.name: Footnote
icons.action: Wick pops up from behind a giant open book with blank ruled pages, one mitten raised, finger pointing skyward to make a point.

icons.name: Lab Coat
icons.action: Wick squats inside a curling cloud of gas, holding up a flask to compare it with the fumes, unbothered as the gas parts around it.

icons.name: Overruled!
icons.action: Wick leaps off both boots, swinging a gavel bigger than its head down onto a sounding block, a motion arc behind it.

icons.name: Burden of Proof
icons.action: Wick holds an empty box upside down at arm's length and shakes it; nothing falls out but a single dust puff.

icons.name: Mirage
icons.action: Wick leans halfway out through a dashed-outline wall that it projects from one raised mitten, giving the trick away.

icons.name: Blueprint
icons.action: Wick kneels over a big unrolled plan, drawing a bold route arrow across it with a chalk stick.

icons.name: Detective's Eye
icons.action: Wick lies prone, chin on the ground, peering through a magnifying glass bigger than its head at one out-of-place footprint.

icons.name: Pattern Lock
icons.action: Wick leans back just far enough as a big blade thrusts past its screen from frame edge, mittens loose and casual.

icons.name: Talks Broke Down
icons.action: From a low squat, Wick heaves a negotiating table up and over, cups and blank papers flying, already grinning.

icons.name: Crowd Pleaser
icons.action: Wick crowd-surfs on its back, arms flung wide, borne along on a wave of tiny raised hands that fills the lower third.

icons.name: Shared Breath
icons.action: Wick kneels, eyes closed, one mitten on its lantern heart; a single ribbon runs from the heart out of frame to a hand gripping it.

icons.name: Lay Down Arms
icons.action: Wick steps close and gently presses a rifle barrel, poking in from frame edge, down toward the ground with one open mitten.

icons.name: Soulmate
icons.action: Wick curls over a tiny Wick silhouette, cape spread over both like a tent, as cracks from a blow spread across Wick's own back.

icons.name: Rally Cry
icons.action: In a deep lunge, Wick drives a torn, blank banner pole into the ground with both mittens, mouth wide in a shout.

icons.name: Sweet Talker
icons.action: Wick lounges on one elbow on thin air, offering a long-stemmed rose; a thorn has pricked its mitten, a tiny pain star at the spot.

icons.name: Double Meaning
icons.action: Wick sits sideways on a low ledge, winking at the viewer, as its single blank speech balloon forks into two tails pointing opposite ways.

icons.name: Heart Overload
icons.action: Wick lunges, thrusting an Emanator gauntlet that pours out a flowing ribbon blast, while thick cracks spider out from its own lantern heart.

icons.name: Resonance
icons.action: Wick crouches holding up a large tuning fork that hums in concentric rings, catching a soul ribbon drifting in from off frame.

icons.name: Old Tongue
icons.action: Wick kneels nose-close to a tall cracked stone slab, tracing its carved spirals and dots (no letters) with one mitten.

icons.name: Rite in the Field
icons.action: Wick lies flat in a shallow trench, hammering a carved ward stake into the dirt with its fist as streaks fly overhead.

icons.name: You Get Used to It
icons.action: Wick holds a big umbrella over a tiny Wick silhouette while a rain of scribbly squiggles pours down, looking utterly bored.

icons.name: Flat Line
icons.action: Wick sits bolt upright on a stool, teacup raised halfway, staring dead at the viewer without moving.

icons.name: Litany
icons.action: Wick kneels with head tilted up, prayer beads wound through both mittens, singing, thin radiant lines fanning above it.

icons.name: Holy Ordnance
icons.action: Normal Wick with its recognisable broad clipped-corner pixel-screen head kneels and raises one oversized blessed artillery shell in both mittens; three bold radiating rays come from the shell only. No knight armour, hood, visor or costume around the head.

icons.name: Red Line
icons.action: Wick leans far back, heels dug in at a thick line on the ground, as a crooked beckoning hand reaches from the far side.

icons.name: Clean Hands
icons.action: Wick sits back on its heels, both empty mittens raised palms-out, a knife it just dropped stuck point-down in the ground before it.

icons.name: Outclassed
icons.action: Wick sits cross-legged on a toppled, empty enemy helmet as big as itself, buffing one mitten on its chest.

icons.name: Real Power
icons.action: Wick crouches beneath a small crown dangling on puppet strings, ignoring it, one mitten pointing up the strings to where they vanish.

icons.name: Charge!
icons.action: Wick sprints flat-out, body leaning almost horizontal, a bayonet rifle levelled ahead, mouth wide in a roar, dust kicking up behind.

icons.name: Make Way
icons.action: Wick strolls chin-high, mittens clasped behind its back, no weapon at all, as two walls of shoulder silhouettes lean away on either side.

icons.name: Just the Repairman
icons.action: Caught in a searchlight cone, Wick strolls past waving cheerily, a big toolbox swinging from the other mitten.

icons.name: Spoon-Feed
icons.action: Wick kneels and holds a huge spoon out to the viewer, a small geometric sigil (lines and angles, no letters) balanced in its bowl.

icons.name: Cultured
icons.action: Wick sits on a stool strumming a small round-bodied lute, eyes closed, one boot tapping, a few music notes drifting up.

icons.name: Dance of Iron
icons.action: Wick turns a one-handed cartwheel, fully upside down, the other mitten firing a pistol back under its body, a muzzle-flash star.

icons.name: Cold Read
icons.action: Wick crouches and peers through a big heart-shaped keyhole plate held up in both mittens like a frame.

icons.name: Fire Sermon
icons.action: Wick lunges forward, thrusting a burning open book with blank pages overhead, mouth wide mid-sermon, radiant lines behind.

icons.name: Silent Partner
icons.action: Wick crouch-walks behind a big leafy branch, holding it as cover for itself and a tiny Wick silhouette tiptoeing in step beside it.

icons.name: Verse of War
icons.action: Wick strikes a poet's pose, one mitten over its lantern heart, the other flung out as a long soul ribbon unspools in one flowing curve.

icons.name: Between Heartbeats
icons.action: Wick steps calmly around a bullet hanging frozen in the air beside its head, one mitten raised to flick it aside.

icons.name: Siege Engine
icons.action: Wick barges shoulder-first through a brick wall, bricks flying and bouncing harmlessly off its shell, never breaking stride.

icons.name: Dead Signal
icons.action: Wick hangs one-handed from a security camera's bracket arm, pulling its cable plug with the other mitten; the camera's head droops.

icons.name: Twin Souls
icons.action: Wick sits on the ground holding a tin-can telephone to its head; the taut string runs straight up out of frame.

icons.name: The Voice
icons.action: Wick stands at parade rest, officer's baton under one arm, staring dead ahead; one heavy sound ring drops from its screen and flattens the dust.

icons.name: War Footing
icons.action: Wick stomps down from a high knee and the ground cracks around it into a three-by-three grid of broken slabs, cape snapping.

icons.name: Last Charge
icons.action: Wick leaps forward at the end of a long charge, sword raised in both mittens, wrapped in a big bubble shield, speed lines far behind.

icons.name: Angel of the Trenches
icons.action: Wick slides in on its knees through a spray of dirt, catching a limp hand dropping into frame, cape flaring behind like wings.

icons.name: Every Lie Is a Door
icons.action: Wick strides unhurried through a towering door that swings wide open for it, tipping a cap toward the viewer.

icons.name: Twin Discipline
icons.action: Wick leaps and claps both mittens overhead: hard geometric sigil lines trail one arm, flowing soul ribbons the other, fusing into one burst.

icons.name: Last Wall
icons.action: Wick plants itself in the gap of a broken brick wall, arms locked wide across the hole, feet braced; a flattened bullet drops off its chest plate.

icons.name: Walking Wounded
icons.action: Wick strides forward mid-step, one leg wrapped in a long trailing bandage, flinging a crutch away over its shoulder.

icons.name: Skin Map
icons.action: Wick kneels low with one mitten pressed flat to the floor; big ripple rings spread out from the palm across the ground to the frame edges.

icons.name: Earthbreaker
icons.action: Wick at the top of an overhead swing, both mittens on a huge sledgehammer, about to bring it down; a deep starburst crack already splits the ground below.

icons.name: Nothing Left to Fear
icons.action: Wick sits cross-legged on top of a giant sleeping monster's horned head (only the head top shows, filling the bottom of the frame), calmly sipping from a teacup.

icons.name: The Name They Whisper
icons.action: Wick stands in a bright open doorway, back-lit, its long shadow stretching all the way toward the viewer; two tiny Wick silhouettes duck behind cover in the foreground.

icons.name: Never There
icons.action: Wick mid-backflip, upside down, with two fading dashed outlines of itself trailing behind; a bullet streaks through the empty outline.

icons.name: Trick Shot
icons.action: Wick fires a revolver backwards over its own shoulder without looking; a dotted line bounces off a tin can and curves out of frame.

icons.name: Before the Blink
icons.action: Wick explodes out of a sprinter's crouch, already one stride gone, beside a big pocket stopwatch whose hand still points straight up.

icons.name: Vanishing Act
icons.action: Wick whips its capelet out into a huge magician's sweep; the lower half of its body is already gone, shown only as a dotted outline.

icons.name: Overhaul
icons.action: Wick sits on the ground cradling a rebuilt rifle across its lap like a prize, one extra rail gleaming, a wrench tucked behind its head like a pencil.

icons.name: Nothing Gets Past
icons.action: Wick kneels with a rifle shouldered inside a wide fan of light sweeping out like a lighthouse beam; three small dash marks sit in the beam where shots landed.

icons.name: Clean Draw
icons.action: Keep the existing one-foot balancing pose and upper-left Mastered mark. One finger traces one bold continuous square spiral sigil with right-angle corners, no star, diamond or spark anywhere within the sigil.

icons.name: Established Fact
icons.action: Wick brings a huge rubber stamp down with both mittens onto a blank sheet, leaving one big checkmark.

icons.name: Closing Argument
icons.action: Wick walks away from the viewer, back turned, cape swinging, having just let go of a microphone that's falling behind it.

icons.name: Solid Image
icons.action: Wick leans its whole weight back against a wall drawn in dashed lines, arms folded, and the dashed wall holds it up.

icons.name: Case Closed
icons.action: Wick perches on the edge of a desk, slapping a thick case folder shut, its string tie flying.

icons.name: Everyone's Friend
icons.action: Wick beams as a stranger's hand (entering from the frame edge) drops a ring of keys into its open mitten.

icons.name: Open Hand
icons.action: Wick kneels and holds out a small flower toward an armoured gauntlet (partial, entering from the side) that is lowering its blade.

icons.name: Many Hands
icons.action: Seen from above: Wick in a team huddle, its mitten at the bottom of a pile of hands stacked from every side of the frame (all partials)../../../../icons/perks

icons.name: Their Own Idea
icons.action: Wick whispers behind one mitten toward a big ear (partial, from the frame edge), above which a lightbulb has just switched on.

icons.name: The Twin Pays
icons.action: Wick holds a soul flame high in one mitten while a coin drops from the top edge of the frame into its other open mitten.

icons.name: Bite the Bullet
icons.action: Wick, dented and smoking, pushes up off one knee with a big bullet clamped sideways across its screen like a bit, one fist planted on the ground.

icons.name: True Name
icons.action: Wick holds up an unrolled scroll showing one sigil (a symbol, never letters) toward a huge horned shadow at the frame edge, which shrinks back.

icons.name: Sixth Sense
icons.action: Wick crouches low with its capelet pulled up like a hood, a humming tuning fork held above its head; a dotted trail of footprints creeps in from behind it.

icons.name: Still Water
icons.action: Wick sits perfectly still on one stepping stone in flat water, a tea bowl balanced on its head, no ripple anywhere.

icons.name: What Could Be
icons.action: Wick holds up a hand mirror toward the viewer; the mirror shows a small sun and a sprouting flower where the frame around Wick is bare.

icons.name: Judgement Day
icons.action: Keep the existing crozier-raising gesture, upper-left Mastered mark and single descending light shaft. The crozier has a PLAIN rounded spiral head, no star-shaped finial or sparkle.

icons.name: Foreseen
icons.action: Wick stands at a signpost at a fork; one arrow is crossed out, and Wick glances back over its shoulder toward it before taking the other road.

icons.name: On My Mark
icons.action: Wick leans forward pointing hard with one mitten, a whistle at its screen, cape snapping; motion lines run the way it points.
